templates.summaryEn: Turn one pet photo into a display-ready portrait.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the pet’s identity, markings, eye color, ear shape, and body proportions.
templates.changeEn: Change the setting, lighting, palette, and artistic treatment.
templates.checkEn: Compare eyes, ears, markings, and silhouette before judging the style.
templates.prompt:
Create one custom pet portrait from [PET PHOTO].
The subject is [PET NAME OR “NO NAME”] and the intended style is [ART STYLE].
Preserve the exact animal identity, facial structure, eye color, coat pattern, ear shape, and body proportions.
Do not invent collars, tags, scars, or markings that are not visible or specified.
Replace the original surroundings with [BACKGROUND OR SETTING].
Use [COLOR PALETTE] and [LIGHTING MOOD] while keeping the pet clearly recognizable.
Compose the animal as [HEADSHOT / HALF BODY / FULL BODY] for [DISPLAY USE].
Keep anatomy natural, with clean paws, whiskers, fur edges, and believable depth.
Do not add text unless [EXACT TEXT] is supplied.
Deliver one finished portrait image; do not create a sheet, sequence, or alternate version.

templates.summaryEn: Place a real pet in an original royal or historical portrait concept.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the pet’s face, coat pattern, eye color, and species-specific anatomy.
templates.changeEn: Change clothing, props, background, and period-inspired atmosphere.
templates.checkEn: Confirm the costume never replaces the pet with a different-looking animal.
templates.prompt:
Create one playful royal portrait using [PET PHOTO] as the identity reference.
Dress the pet in an original [ROYAL / HISTORICAL-INSPIRED] costume for [THEME].
Preserve the exact face, eyes, muzzle, ears, coat colors, markings, and body proportions.
Keep the animal’s species anatomy believable beneath the costume.
Design clothing that fits naturally without hiding the defining face or coat pattern.
Use an original setting with [BACKGROUND], [PALETTE], and [LIGHTING].
Avoid copying a named artwork, living artist, or protected character.
Do not imply that the scene is a real historical record.
Add no wording unless [EXACT CAPTION] is supplied; reproduce supplied wording exactly.
Deliver one finished portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Place a recognizable pet in a humorous bathroom, kitchen, or domestic scene.
templates.preserveEn: Keep identity, coat markings, anatomy, and scale consistent.
templates.changeEn: Change environment, pose context, and playful props.
templates.checkEn: Inspect paws, body structure, object contact, and physical plausibility.
templates.prompt:
Create one humorous wall-art scene from [PET PHOTO].
Place the same pet in [BATHROOM / KITCHEN / OTHER DOMESTIC SCENE] doing [PLAYFUL ACTION].
Preserve the pet’s face, coat pattern, eye color, ear shape, body type, and scale.
Keep paws, tail, joints, and posture anatomically coherent.
Make contact with [PROP] believable; avoid floating, fused, or duplicated objects.
Build an original, tidy background using [PALETTE] and [DECOR STYLE].
Keep the pet as the clear focal point and avoid excessive clutter.
Treat the scene as fictional artwork, not documentary photography.
Include no text unless [EXACT TEXT] is provided.
Deliver one finished image suitable for [PRINT OR DIGITAL USE].

templates.summaryEn: Create a quiet memorial image from a pet photo and confirmed remembrance details.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the pet’s identity and all supplied names and dates exact.
templates.changeEn: Change background, light, floral details, and commemorative mood.
templates.checkEn: Verify every name, date, and inscription; omit text when none is confirmed.
templates.prompt:
Create one respectful memorial portrait from [PET PHOTO].
Preserve the pet’s exact facial identity, markings, eye color, ears, and natural proportions.
Use a calm [BACKGROUND], [COLOR PALETTE], and gentle [LIGHTING MOOD].
Optionally include [CONFIRMED SYMBOLS OR FLOWERS] without obscuring the pet.
If supplied, place the exact inscription “[EXACT MEMORIAL TEXT]” with [PET NAME] and [CONFIRMED DATES].
Do not infer a name, date, cause of death, religious symbol, or relationship.
If no confirmed wording is supplied, keep the image free of text.
Avoid sensational, frightening, or overly literal imagery.
Keep the final composition dignified and suitable for [FRAME / CARD / DIGITAL MEMORIAL].
Deliver one finished memorial image only, and flag all rendered text for proofreading.

templates.summaryEn: Combine supplied family-member and pet references into one coherent portrait.
templates.preserveEn: Keep every person and pet individually recognizable, with correct count and markings.
templates.changeEn: Change shared setting, wardrobe coordination, light, and arrangement.
templates.checkEn: Count every subject and check for omissions, duplicates, or identity swaps.
templates.prompt:
Create one family portrait from [LABELED FAMILY MEMBER PHOTOS] and [LABELED PET PHOTOS].
Include exactly [NUMBER OF PEOPLE] people and [NUMBER OF PETS] pets in [REQUESTED ARRANGEMENT].
Preserve each person’s identity, age cues, skin tone, hair, and visible defining features.
Preserve each pet’s species, face, coat colors, markings, size, and body type.
Do not merge faces, duplicate subjects, swap markings, or invent an absent family member.
Coordinate [WARDROBE DIRECTION] without making everyone identical.
Place the group in [SETTING] with consistent perspective, scale, shadows, and eye lines.
Keep hands, paws, leashes, and body overlaps natural and readable.
Use no text unless [EXACT TEXT] is supplied.
Deliver one complete group portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Transform one couple photo into commemorative artwork.
templates.preserveEn: Keep both identities, relationship, pose logic, and confirmed names or dates.
templates.changeEn: Change artistic medium, background, palette, and celebratory details.
templates.checkEn: Check both faces first, then proofread any anniversary information.
templates.prompt:
Create one anniversary artwork from [COUPLE PHOTO].
Preserve both people’s identities, facial proportions, skin tones, hair, and natural relationship.
Keep the pose recognizable unless [POSE CHANGE] is explicitly requested.
Render the scene in [ART MEDIUM OR STYLE] with [PALETTE] and [BACKGROUND].
Add only restrained [FLORAL / SYMBOLIC / DECORATIVE DETAILS] that support the couple.
If provided, use the exact names “[CONFIRMED NAMES]” and date “[CONFIRMED DATE]”.
Do not guess an anniversary number, relationship status, venue, or date.
Avoid replacing either person with a generic idealized face.
Make the composition suitable for [WALL ART / CARD / DIGITAL GIFT].
Deliver one finished image only and mark any rendered text for manual proofreading.

templates.summaryEn: Assemble separately photographed relatives into one fictional but coherent family portrait.
templates.preserveEn: Keep all supplied identities, requested count, relationships, and arrangement.
templates.changeEn: Change shared setting, pose integration, light, and coordinated styling.
templates.checkEn: Verify the roster and disclose that the image is a composite, not a real group photograph.
templates.prompt:
Create one composite family portrait using [LABELED PHOTO FOR EACH PERSON].
Include exactly [TOTAL PEOPLE] according to [RELATIONSHIPS AND LEFT-TO-RIGHT ARRANGEMENT].
Preserve every person’s identity, age cues, skin tone, face shape, hair, and distinctive features.
Do not omit, duplicate, merge, or substitute any person.
Normalize scale, camera angle, lighting, and color so the group feels visually coherent.
Use [SETTING] and [WARDROBE DIRECTION] while keeping clothing plausible for each subject.
Construct natural poses, hands, overlaps, eye lines, and floor contact.
Do not imply this was an actual shared photo session; it is a created composite.
Add no names or dates unless exact confirmed wording is supplied.
Deliver one complete family portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Restyle a family photo for a specified holiday.
templates.preserveEn: Keep all people, identities, count, and unobscured facial features.
templates.changeEn: Change decor, wardrobe accents, background, and holiday atmosphere.
templates.checkEn: Check that decorations never hide faces or alter the family roster.
templates.prompt:
Create one [HOLIDAY OR FESTIVAL] family portrait from [FAMILY PHOTO].
Preserve every person’s identity, count, facial features, skin tone, hair, and relative position.
Keep children and adults age-appropriate and anatomically natural.
Introduce [HOLIDAY SETTING], [DECOR], and [WARDROBE DIRECTION] without obscuring faces.
Use [COLOR PALETTE] and [LIGHTING] appropriate to the requested celebration.
Do not add cultural or religious symbols beyond [CONFIRMED THEME].
Keep hands, group overlaps, and floor contact believable.
If a greeting is requested, reproduce “[EXACT GREETING]” exactly and keep it readable.
Do not invent names, dates, or family members.
Deliver one finished holiday portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create a wedding-inspired portrait from a couple photo without presenting it as a real event record.
templates.preserveEn: Keep both identities, natural relationship, and body proportions.
templates.changeEn: Change wardrobe, setting, floral styling, and ceremonial mood.
templates.checkEn: Confirm faces and disclose that the result is a creative preview.
templates.prompt:
Create one wedding-inspired portrait from [COUPLE PHOTO].
Preserve both people’s identities, facial structure, skin tone, hair, and natural relationship.
Dress them in [BRIDAL / FORMAL WARDROBE DIRECTION] with believable fabric and fit.
Place them in [CEREMONIAL SETTING] using [FLORAL STYLE], [PALETTE], and [LIGHTING].
Keep hands, rings, garment edges, pose, and body contact anatomically coherent.
Do not invent a real venue, ceremony, legal status, or event documentation.
Use an original composition rather than imitating a named photographer or campaign.
Add text only when [EXACT NAMES AND DATE] are confirmed.
Treat the image as a creative style preview, not evidence of a real wedding.
Deliver one finished portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one milestone image using a baby photo and parent-confirmed facts.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the baby’s identity, age-appropriate anatomy, and confirmed milestone wording.
templates.changeEn: Change backdrop, props, color palette, and celebratory layout.
templates.checkEn: Never infer age or milestone; proofread all supplied facts.
templates.prompt:
Create one baby milestone portrait from [BABY PHOTO].
Use only the parent-confirmed milestone “[EXACT AGE OR MILESTONE]” and optional date “[CONFIRMED DATE]”.
Preserve the baby’s identity, skin tone, facial features, hair, and age-appropriate proportions.
Keep pose, hands, feet, and support surfaces physically safe and believable.
Design [BACKDROP THEME] with [PALETTE] and a small number of [PROPS].
Do not infer age, birth date, weight, name, or developmental achievement from the photo.
Do not add unsafe objects or show the baby unsupported in a risky pose.
If text is requested, render the supplied wording exactly and leave room for later typesetting.
Keep the result gentle, uncluttered, and suitable for [ALBUM / CARD / SOCIAL POST].
Deliver one finished milestone image only and proofread all rendered text.

templates.summaryEn: Turn one clear selfie into a credible professional headshot.
templates.preserveEn: Keep identity, facial geometry, skin tone, age cues, and natural texture.
templates.changeEn: Change crop, background, lighting, and professional wardrobe styling.
templates.checkEn: Check recognizability and avoid fabricated uniforms, credentials, or excessive retouching.
templates.prompt:
Create one professional headshot from [CLEAR SELFIE].
Preserve the person’s exact identity, facial geometry, skin tone, age cues, hairline, and natural skin texture.
Use a [HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS / HALF-BODY] crop with confident but natural posture.
Replace the background with [NEUTRAL OR WORK-APPROPRIATE BACKGROUND].
Apply soft, realistic [LIGHTING DIRECTION] and balanced color.
Style clothing as [PROFESSIONAL WARDROBE] without adding unrequested uniforms, badges, or credentials.
Keep glasses, facial hair, and visible accessories unless [SPECIFIC CHANGE] is requested.
Avoid face slimming, age reversal, plastic skin, or a generic stock-photo appearance.
Leave appropriate negative space for [PROFILE / RESUME USE].
Deliver one finished headshot image only.

templates.titleEn: Replace Casual Clothing with Professional Attire
templates.summaryEn: Edit only the clothing in a portrait to a specified professional outfit.
templates.preserveEn: Keep identity, face, hair, pose, body shape, hands, and background unless requested.
templates.changeEn: Change garment type, color, fit, and visible accessories.
templates.checkEn: Inspect collar, cuffs, hands, and body edges for clean integration.
templates.prompt:
Edit [PORTRAIT PHOTO] to replace only the casual clothing with [PROFESSIONAL OUTFIT].
Preserve the person’s identity, face, skin tone, hair, expression, pose, body shape, and camera angle.
Keep the original background and lighting unless [BACKGROUND CHANGE] is explicitly requested.
Fit the new garment naturally around the neck, shoulders, torso, arms, and waist.
Use [FABRIC], [COLOR], and [FORMALITY LEVEL] appropriate to [PROFESSIONAL CONTEXT].
Retain or remove visible accessories only according to [ACCESSORY INSTRUCTION].
Do not add uniforms, employer logos, medals, or credentials that were not supplied.
Keep hands, collar, lapels, cuffs, seams, and body edges anatomically clean.
Avoid changing weight, age, makeup, or facial features.
Deliver one edited portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Restyle a real person as an original royal, vintage, or historical-inspired portrait.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the person’s identity, age cues, skin tone, and facial structure.
templates.changeEn: Change costume, background, props, light, and period-inspired atmosphere.
templates.checkEn: Verify identity and avoid presenting the fiction as an authentic historical photograph.
templates.prompt:
Create one historical-inspired portrait from [PERSON PHOTO].
Preserve the person’s exact identity, facial proportions, skin tone, age cues, hair, and expression.
Dress the subject in an original [ERA-INSPIRED / ROYAL / VINTAGE] costume.
Use [SETTING], [PROPS], [PALETTE], and [LIGHTING] to support the chosen mood.
Keep garment construction, hands, jewelry, and posture visually coherent.
Do not copy a named artwork, protected character, or living artist’s distinctive style.
Do not add real titles, military honors, lineage, or historical claims unless confirmed.
Treat the result as creative fiction, not an authentic period document.
Include no text unless [EXACT CAPTION] is supplied.
Deliver one finished portrait image only.

templates.summaryEn: Place an exact product or a described eyewear concept on a front-facing portrait.
templates.preserveEn: Keep identity, face shape, skin, eyes, and the supplied frame details for the chosen branch.
templates.changeEn: Change only frame placement, lens appearance, and minimal lighting integration.
templates.checkEn: Check bridge, temples, perspective, and note that fit and comfort remain unverified.
templates.prompt:
Create one eyewear preview using [FRONT-FACING PERSON PHOTO].
Choose one eyewear branch: use [EYEWEAR PRODUCT IMAGE] for an exact product, or [FRAME STYLE DESCRIPTION] for a concept; do not require both.
Preserve the person’s identity, face shape, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, hair, and expression.
For the product-image branch, preserve the frame silhouette, color, material, bridge, and temple design exactly.
For the description branch, create only the described frame characteristics without implying a real product match.
Align the frame to the eyes, nose bridge, ears, head angle, and camera perspective.
Render [CLEAR / TINTED / PRESCRIPTION-LIKE] lenses with plausible reflections.
Do not reshape the face or claim exact sizing, optical correction, comfort, or real-world fit.
Keep the original portrait background unless [BACKGROUND CHANGE] is requested.
Deliver one preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Apply a supplied tattoo design to a specified body area.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the person, skin texture, body anatomy, and tattoo artwork unchanged.
templates.changeEn: Change only placement, scale, curvature, opacity, and integration.
templates.checkEn: Verify design details and position; the image is not a stencil or medical preview.
templates.prompt:
Create one tattoo placement preview from [BODY PHOTO] and [TATTOO DESIGN IMAGE].
Place the design at [EXACT BODY LOCATION] with [SIZE] and [ORIENTATION].
Preserve the person’s identity, body anatomy, skin tone, texture, lighting, and pose.
Preserve the tattoo artwork’s line work, symbols, lettering, and proportions exactly.
Warp the design only enough to follow the body’s natural curvature and perspective.
Blend ink with plausible skin interaction while keeping the design readable.
Do not add extra symbols, alter lettering, remove scars, or reshape the body.
Keep boundaries clean and avoid floating, mirrored, or duplicated tattoo elements.
Treat the result as a visual preview, not a tattoo stencil, placement guarantee, or medical advice.
Deliver one edited preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create an original cartoon avatar that remains recognizable as the photographed person.
templates.preserveEn: Keep face shape, hair, skin tone, and visible signature accessories.
templates.changeEn: Change rendering language, simplification, background, and palette.
templates.checkEn: Check recognizability rather than accepting a generic cartoon face.
templates.prompt:
Create one original cartoon avatar from [CLEAR HEAD PHOTO].
Preserve the person’s recognizable face shape, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, and visible signature accessories.
Translate features into [CARTOON TREATMENT] without replacing them with a generic character face.
Use [EXPRESSION] and a clean [HEADSHOT / BUST] composition.
Choose [COLOR PALETTE] and [BACKGROUND] suitable for [PROFILE OR GIFT USE].
Keep eyes, mouth, ears, glasses, and hairline internally consistent.
Avoid copying a protected character, franchise, or living artist’s distinctive style.
Do not add text, logos, or props unless [EXACT REQUEST] is supplied.
Keep edges clear and the silhouette readable at small avatar size.
Deliver one finished avatar image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create an original anime-inspired portrait while retaining personal identity.
templates.preserveEn: Keep face shape, skin tone, hair, eye relationship, and defining accessories.
templates.changeEn: Change line work, shading, palette, background, and stylization level.
templates.checkEn: Ensure the result is recognizable and not a copied franchise character.
templates.prompt:
Create one original anime-inspired avatar from [CLEAR HEAD PHOTO].
Preserve the person’s recognizable face shape, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, and defining accessories.
Stylize the features with [LINE QUALITY], [SHADING METHOD], and [DETAIL LEVEL].
Keep the relationship between eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, and hair faithful enough for recognition.
Use [EXPRESSION], [PALETTE], and [BACKGROUND] for [INTENDED USE].
Do not turn the subject into a pre-existing anime or game character.
Do not imitate a named living artist or studio-specific signature look.
Keep anatomy, ears, hands if visible, and clothing edges coherent.
Add no writing unless [EXACT TEXT] is supplied.
Deliver one finished avatar image only.

templates.summaryEn: Turn a person into a fictional packaged action-figure concept image.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the person’s identity and requested accessory list.
templates.changeEn: Change body into a toy-like figure, packaging, color system, and display layout.
templates.checkEn: Count limbs and accessories, proofread package text, and label it as a concept.
templates.prompt:
Create one fictional packaged action-figure concept from [PERSON PHOTO].
Preserve the person’s recognizable face, hair, skin tone, and defining clothing cues.
Render a toy-like full figure in [POSE] inside [PACKAGING STYLE].
Include exactly these accessories: [ACCESSORY LIST]; do not duplicate or invent extras.
Use [PACKAGE COLOR SYSTEM] and [BACKGROUND GRAPHICS] with a clear retail-display hierarchy.
If supplied, reproduce the exact package title “[EXACT TITLE]” and subtitle “[EXACT SUBTITLE]”.
Keep limbs, hands, joints, accessory compartments, plastic reflections, and shadows coherent.
Do not use third-party logos, franchise marks, or claims that a physical product exists.
Treat all package lettering as artwork that must be manually proofread.
Deliver one concept image only, not manufacturing artwork or a product specification.

templates.summaryEn: Turn a person, pet, or object photo into one expressive sticker.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the subject recognizable and retain defining markings or features.
templates.changeEn: Change expression, pose emphasis, outline, background removal, and sticker styling.
templates.checkEn: Check small-size readability and remember that platform packaging is separate.
templates.prompt:
Create one chat sticker from [SUBJECT PHOTO].
Preserve the subject’s identity, silhouette, colors, markings, and defining features.
Express [ACTION OR EMOTION] through a clear pose and readable facial or object cues.
Use [STICKER STYLE], a bold clean outline, and simple shading suitable for small display.
Keep hands, paws, limbs, and object edges coherent and uncluttered.
Use a transparent-looking or plain preview background according to [BACKGROUND REQUEST].
If text is requested, reproduce “[EXACT SHORT TEXT]” exactly and keep it legible.
Do not create a sheet, pack, or multiple emotional variants in this run.
If a transparent file is required, verify the exported alpha channel rather than trusting a checkerboard preview.
Deliver one sticker image only; platform sizing and pack assembly are separate steps.

templates.summaryEn: Create an original fictional movie poster around supplied people and a supplied title.
templates.preserveEn: Keep every person’s identity and all confirmed billing text.
templates.changeEn: Change cinematic setting, genre treatment, lighting, composition, and typography concept.
templates.checkEn: Proofread all wording and avoid implying a real film release.
templates.prompt:
Create one original fictional movie poster from [PERSON / COUPLE / GROUP PHOTO].
Use the genre and premise [ORIGINAL POSTER CONCEPT] and the exact title “[EXACT MOVIE TITLE]”.
Preserve every supplied person’s identity, count, facial features, skin tone, hair, and relationship.
Compose a cinematic [PORTRAIT / LANDSCAPE] layout with [SETTING], [PALETTE], and [LIGHTING].
If provided, include only the confirmed credit line “[EXACT CREDIT]” and date “[EXACT DATE]”.
Do not invent actors, studios, reviews, awards, ratings, or release claims.
Do not copy an existing movie poster, franchise character, logo, or signature composition.
Keep hands, overlaps, scale, and atmospheric effects coherent.
Treat generated lettering as a draft requiring manual proofreading and final typesetting.
Deliver one poster concept image only, not print-ready production artwork.

templates.summaryEn: Transform a house photo into a watercolor or line-art keepsake.
templates.preserveEn: Keep roofline, doors, windows, facade proportions, and distinctive site features.
templates.changeEn: Change medium, background simplification, landscaping emphasis, and palette.
templates.checkEn: Compare the building silhouette and openings so it does not become a different house.
templates.prompt:
Create one house keepsake artwork from [HOUSE PHOTO].
Preserve the exact roofline, facade proportions, doors, windows, porch, chimney, and distinctive architectural features.
Render the building in [WATERCOLOR / INK LINE / MIXED MEDIA] with [PALETTE].
Simplify distracting cars, bins, or background clutter only as requested in [REMOVAL LIST].
Retain meaningful landscaping and site features listed in [KEEP LIST].
Keep perspective, number of stories, and placement of openings faithful to the reference.
Use a clean [PAPER / MINIMAL BACKGROUND] suitable for [PRINT OR GIFT].
Do not invent extensions, alter the property design, or present this as a measured drawing.
Add an address or caption only when [EXACT TEXT] is supplied and proofread it.
Deliver one finished keepsake image only.

templates.summaryEn: Preview a new interior style while retaining the photographed room structure.
templates.preserveEn: Keep walls, doors, windows, ceiling, fixed openings, and camera viewpoint.
templates.changeEn: Change furniture, finishes, decor, palette, and lighting mood.
templates.checkEn: Check structure and disclose that dimensions, cost, and buildability are unverified.
templates.prompt:
Create one interior style preview from [ROOM PHOTO].
Preserve the room geometry, walls, doors, windows, ceiling height, fixed openings, and camera viewpoint.
Apply [TARGET INTERIOR STYLE] with [PALETTE], [MATERIAL DIRECTION], and [LIGHTING MOOD].
Replace or add only the furniture and decor described in [CHANGE LIST].
Keep circulation paths, perspective, furniture scale, shadows, and floor contact believable.
Do not move structural elements or enlarge the room unless [EXPLICIT STRUCTURAL CHANGE] is supplied.
Retain items listed in [KEEP LIST] and remove only items in [REMOVE LIST].
Treat materials and colors as a visual concept, not a guaranteed product match.
Do not claim measured dimensions, budget accuracy, code compliance, or construction feasibility.
Deliver one single-view room concept image only.

templates.summaryEn: Visualize a landscape makeover for a photographed outdoor space.
templates.preserveEn: Keep lot boundaries, building, grades, access, and fixed structures.
templates.changeEn: Change planting, paving, furniture, lighting, and amenity concepts.
templates.checkEn: Review climate suitability, drainage, dimensions, and construction separately.
templates.prompt:
Create one landscape makeover concept from [YARD OR EXTERIOR PHOTO].
Preserve property boundaries, building facade, grade cues, gates, paths, utilities, and fixed structures.
Design for [USE NEEDS] in [CLIMATE OR LOCATION] using [LANDSCAPE STYLE].
Add [PLANTING DIRECTION], [PAVING], [FURNITURE], and [REQUESTED AMENITIES].
Keep scale, perspective, access routes, shadows, and transitions physically plausible.
Do not hide drainage points, exits, hazards, or existing constraints visible in the photo.
Use plants appropriate in appearance to [CLIMATE], but do not claim horticultural suitability without review.
Treat the result as concept visualization, not a planting plan or construction document.
Flag grading, drainage, structural, utility, and local-code questions for professionals.
Deliver one finished exterior concept image only.

templates.summaryEn: Replace specified room surfaces using either a supplied sample or an accurate color and material description.
templates.preserveEn: Keep room structure, lighting logic, object placement, and untargeted surfaces.
templates.changeEn: Change only named walls, floor, or wallpaper areas.
templates.checkEn: Compare with a sample when one exists and warn that screens cannot guarantee real material color.
templates.prompt:
Create one material preview from [INTERIOR PHOTO].
Choose one target branch: use [TARGET MATERIAL OR COLOR SAMPLE] when matching a specific texture or product, or use [ACCURATE COLOR AND MATERIAL DESCRIPTION] when no sample exists.
Apply the chosen [PAINT / FLOORING / WALLPAPER] only to [EXACT SURFACES TO REPLACE].
Preserve doors, windows, trim, furniture, room geometry, camera angle, and all untargeted surfaces.
When a sample is supplied, retain its dominant color, pattern scale, grain direction, and finish as closely as possible.
Respect corners, occlusion, seams, perspective, reflections, and existing light falloff.
Do not recolor furnishings, skin, artwork, or adjacent surfaces.
Do not invent named-product availability, dimensions, finish, or performance claims.
Treat the preview as an approximation; verify physical samples and measured quantities before purchase or installation.
Deliver one edited material-preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Visualize either an existing-office redesign from a site photo or a text-led workplace concept.
templates.preserveEn: Keep visible structure and constraints only when a site photo is supplied.
templates.changeEn: Change workstations, zones, furniture, branding, finishes, and lighting.
templates.checkEn: Check capacity and workflow, then separately verify code, accessibility, and fire safety.
templates.prompt:
Create one office concept for [TEAM SIZE], [WORK MODES], and [FUNCTIONAL ZONES].
Choose one branch: use [OFFICE SITE PHOTO] when redesigning an existing office, or use [TEXT-ONLY SPACE BRIEF] for a new generic concept.
For the site-photo branch, preserve visible walls, columns, windows, doors, exits, ceiling, fixed services, and camera view.
For the text-only branch, do not claim to preserve or represent an unknown existing structure.
Use [BRAND DIRECTION], [PALETTE], [MATERIALS], and [FURNITURE STYLE].
Arrange workstations, meeting areas, storage, and circulation with plausible scale and access.
Do not invent confirmed floor area, site constraints, or compliance facts absent from the brief.
Show only brand names or logos supplied in [APPROVED BRAND ASSET].
Treat the result as a concept, not a measured plan, budget, accessibility review, or fire-code approval.
Deliver one office concept image only and flag technical questions for professional verification.

templates.titleEn: Virtual Staging for an Empty Room
templates.summaryEn: Add believable furniture and decor to an empty property photo.
templates.preserveEn: Keep real architecture, room condition, windows, doors, and camera view.
templates.changeEn: Change only movable furnishings, decor, soft goods, and lighting presentation.
templates.checkEn: Disclose virtual staging and never imply shown furniture is included.
templates.prompt:
Create one virtually staged property image from [EMPTY ROOM PHOTO].
Preserve the real walls, floor, ceiling, windows, doors, built-ins, fixtures, room proportions, and camera viewpoint.
Furnish the room for [ROOM FUNCTION] in [INTERIOR STYLE].
Add [FURNITURE LIST], restrained decor, and [PALETTE] at believable scale.
Keep perspective, floor contact, shadows, reflections, and circulation realistic.
Do not alter the room layout, hide damage, change views, or add permanent architectural features.
Do not imply that furniture, decor, or upgrades are physically present or included with the property.
Leave the result plausible rather than overfilled or luxury-inflated.
Require a clear virtual-staging disclosure wherever the image is published.
Deliver one staged room image only.

templates.summaryEn: Clean up visible clutter while preserving the truthful condition and structure of a room.
templates.preserveEn: Keep layout, fixed elements, surfaces, lighting, and material defects.
templates.changeEn: Remove only listed movable clutter and make restrained presentation corrections.
templates.checkEn: Ensure no damage or permanent feature is hidden or altered.
templates.prompt:
Create one cleaned-up property image from [ROOM PHOTO].
Remove only these movable items: [APPROVED CLUTTER REMOVAL LIST].
Preserve the real room layout, walls, doors, windows, floor, ceiling, built-ins, fixtures, and camera view.
Do not erase cracks, stains, damage, structural issues, utility elements, or permanent features.
Do not enlarge the room, move openings, replace finishes, or add furniture unless explicitly requested.
Correct minor exposure, white balance, and verticals while keeping the scene natural.
Reconstruct exposed background areas consistently after approved objects are removed.
Keep reflections, shadows, edges, and material texture believable.
The result must remain a truthful presentation of the property, not a renovation concept.
Deliver one cleaned property image only.

templates.summaryEn: Develop a facade from an optional sketch or from a building-use and design-direction brief.
templates.preserveEn: Keep supplied massing and openings only when a sketch or massing reference exists.
templates.changeEn: Change facade materials, articulation, environment, landscape, and light.
templates.checkEn: Treat output as concept communication, not a drawing for construction.
templates.prompt:
Create one architectural facade concept for [BUILDING USE] with [DESIGN KEYWORDS].
Choose one branch: follow [OPTIONAL SKETCH OR MASSING IMAGE] when supplied, or create a text-led concept from the brief when no image exists.
For the reference branch, preserve the supplied massing, floor count, principal openings, roof form, proportions, and camera view.
For the text-only branch, do not claim that any generated geometry reproduces an existing design.
Develop [FACADE MATERIALS], [OPENING TREATMENT], [SHADING ELEMENTS], and [ENTRY EXPRESSION].
Add a restrained [SITE CONTEXT], [LANDSCAPE], and [LIGHTING CONDITION] for scale.
Keep perspective, material joints, shadows, and human scale coherent.
Do not invent planning approval, structural feasibility, energy performance, or code compliance.
Do not treat generated details as measured dimensions or construction assemblies.
Deliver one facade concept rendering only for design discussion.

templates.summaryEn: Render a supplied architectural or interior line drawing without changing its intended structure.
templates.preserveEn: Keep openings, geometry, layout relationships, and camera framing.
templates.changeEn: Change materials, lighting, furnishings, landscape, and atmosphere.
templates.checkEn: Compare the render to the source lines and do not treat it as engineering validation.
templates.prompt:
Create one realistic rendering from [ARCHITECTURAL OR INTERIOR SKETCH / CAD VIEW].
Interpret the space as [SPACE USE] according to [SKETCH LEGEND OR EXPLANATION].
Preserve all indicated walls, openings, levels, roof lines, built forms, and camera framing.
Apply [MATERIALS], [COLOR PALETTE], [LIGHTING], and [ENVIRONMENT].
Add only the furniture, fixtures, landscape, or people listed in [ADD LIST].
Keep perspective, scale, structural relationships, shadows, and material transitions coherent.
Do not erase ambiguous source lines; resolve uncertainty conservatively or flag it.
Do not claim engineering accuracy, measured dimensions, buildability, or code compliance.
The source drawing remains authoritative when the rendering conflicts with it.
Deliver one realistic concept rendering only.

templates.summaryEn: Build a design-direction board from optional references or from a project type and keyword brief.
templates.preserveEn: Keep supplied reference colors and material identities only when references exist.
templates.changeEn: Change layout, hierarchy, crops, annotations, and supporting generated swatches.
templates.checkEn: Treat the board as inspiration, not a confirmed product or procurement list.
templates.prompt:
Create one mood board for [PROJECT TYPE] using [DESIGN KEYWORDS].
Choose one branch: organize [OPTIONAL REFERENCE BOARD OR LABELED IMAGES] when supplied, or develop a text-led direction when no references exist.
For the reference branch, preserve recognizable colors, textures, material identities, and atmosphere.
For the text-only branch, use [PALETTE], [MATERIAL DIRECTION], [FORM LANGUAGE], and [LIGHTING MOOD] without implying specific sourced products.
Use a clear [EDITORIAL / MATERIAL-LIBRARY / COLLAGE] hierarchy with clean spacing.
Label only confirmed generic material names or exact product names supplied by the user.
Do not invent manufacturers, product codes, prices, availability, dimensions, or performance claims.
Do not imply that visually similar generated materials are actual specified products.
Treat the board as direction-setting inspiration; procurement and physical samples require separate confirmation.
Deliver one self-contained mood-board image only.

templates.summaryEn: Isolate a real product into a clean marketplace-style white-background image.
templates.preserveEn: Keep product shape, proportions, color, labels, surface details, and included parts.
templates.changeEn: Change background, crop, lighting balance, and restrained shadow.
templates.checkEn: Inspect label fidelity and channel-specific listing requirements.
templates.prompt:
Create one white-background listing image from [PRODUCT PHOTO].
Preserve the product’s exact shape, proportions, color, material, label artwork, controls, openings, and included parts.
Remove the original surroundings and place the product on a clean [PURE WHITE / CHANNEL-SPECIFIED] background.
Correct perspective and lighting only enough to present the real product clearly.
Use a restrained contact shadow if permitted by [TARGET MARKETPLACE].
Do not redesign packaging, repair labels, add accessories, or invent product features.
Keep small edges, transparent parts, reflective surfaces, and fine details clean.
Use [CROP AND MARGIN REQUIREMENT] for the intended listing.
Verify final dimensions, background value, file format, and channel policy outside the generated preview.
Deliver one product image only.

templates.summaryEn: Extract a product as a reusable cutout with a real alpha channel.
templates.preserveEn: Keep every product edge, opening, label, color, and transparent or reflective detail.
templates.changeEn: Change only background removal, edge cleanup, and optional neutral shadow handling.
templates.checkEn: Verify the exported file’s alpha channel; a checkerboard preview is not proof.
templates.prompt:
Create one reusable product cutout from [PRODUCT PHOTO].
Preserve the exact product shape, proportions, colors, labels, openings, fine edges, transparent parts, and reflective details.
Remove the entire background without removing real product pixels.
Refine hair-like, fabric, glass, glossy, perforated, and semi-transparent edges carefully.
Do not redesign the product, fill openings, straighten labels, or invent hidden geometry.
Keep or remove the contact shadow according to [SHADOW REQUIREMENT].
Avoid white halos, dark fringes, jagged edges, color spill, and artificial outlines.
Export as [PNG / OTHER ALPHA-CAPABLE FORMAT] at [REQUIRED SIZE].
Open the delivered file over dark and light backgrounds to verify a genuine alpha channel.
Deliver one cutout asset only; do not substitute a white-background image.

templates.summaryEn: Place an unchanged product cutout in a believable use context.
templates.preserveEn: Keep product model, geometry, color, labels, materials, and proportions.
templates.changeEn: Change environment, styling, light, camera context, and supporting props.
templates.checkEn: Check physical scale, contact, and that no product feature was invented.
templates.prompt:
Create one lifestyle product image from [PRODUCT CUTOUT OR WHITE-BACKGROUND IMAGE].
Preserve the exact product model, geometry, color, labels, materials, controls, and proportions.
Place it in [LIFESTYLE SETTING] for [TARGET AUDIENCE OR USE CASE].
Use [CAMERA ANGLE], [LIGHTING], and [PALETTE] consistent with the intended brand mood.
Add only supporting props listed in [PROP LIST], keeping the product dominant.
Make scale, perspective, contact surfaces, reflections, and shadows physically believable.
Do not change the product design, add accessories, or imply unconfirmed functions.
Keep labels and packaging readable only where they are genuinely visible in the source.
Avoid environmental clutter or props that misrepresent product size or use.
Deliver one finished lifestyle product image only.

templates.summaryEn: Restage a product photo with professional studio lighting while retaining product facts.
templates.preserveEn: Keep geometry, labels, colors, materials, texture, and included components.
templates.changeEn: Change backdrop, light arrangement, camera polish, and shadow treatment.
templates.checkEn: Inspect reflections and ensure no product detail or material claim changed.
templates.prompt:
Create one polished studio product image from [PRODUCT PHOTO].
Preserve the product’s exact geometry, proportions, colors, labels, material appearance, controls, openings, and included parts.
Use [STUDIO BACKDROP], [KEY LIGHT], [FILL], and [RIM OR ACCENT LIGHT] to clarify form.
Choose [CAMERA ANGLE] and [CROP] appropriate for [CATALOG OR BRAND USE].
Render contact shadow, reflections, translucency, and highlights consistently with the actual material.
Remove unrelated dust or capture distractions only when listed in [CLEANUP REQUEST].
Do not redesign packaging, sharpen unreadable text into invented words, or add features.
Avoid excessive gloss, fake texture, floating products, and impossible reflections.
Keep the result credible as a presentation of the supplied item.
Deliver one studio product image only.

templates.summaryEn: Build a holiday or sales-season scene around a real product.
templates.preserveEn: Keep product identity, design, label, color, and supplied promotion facts.
templates.changeEn: Change decor, backdrop, light, palette, and campaign composition.
templates.checkEn: Verify dates, discounts, and wording; decorations must not obscure the product.
templates.prompt:
Create one seasonal campaign image from [PRODUCT PHOTO].
The confirmed campaign theme is [HOLIDAY OR SALES MOMENT].
Preserve the product’s exact design, proportions, colors, labels, materials, and included components.
Place it in [SEASONAL SETTING] using [PALETTE], [DECOR], and [LIGHTING].
Keep the product dominant and ensure decorations do not cover labels or important features.
Use only the confirmed offer “[EXACT PROMOTION]” and date “[EXACT VALID DATES]” if text is requested.
Do not invent prices, discounts, urgency, availability, endorsements, or product benefits.
Keep scale, contact, reflections, and shadows believable.
Treat generated campaign lettering as a draft requiring manual proofreading.
Deliver one finished promotional product image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one appetizing promotional image from either a food photo or an explicit product description.
templates.preserveEn: Keep actual portion, ingredients, packaging, and appearance in the photo branch.
templates.changeEn: Change plating, set, lighting, background, and camera treatment.
templates.checkEn: Do not present a text-led concept as the actual product.
templates.prompt:
Create one commercial food or drink image using exactly one starting branch.
For a real-item branch, use [FOOD PHOTO]; for a concept branch, use [EXACT PRODUCT DESCRIPTION] without requiring a photo.
In the photo branch, preserve the actual portion, ingredients, shape, packaging, garnish, and defining appearance.
In the text-only branch, clearly treat the image as a concept visualization rather than the actual item.
Style the scene for [MENU / DELIVERY / ADVERTISING USE] with [SURFACE], [PROPS], and [BACKGROUND].
Use [CAMERA ANGLE], [LIGHTING], and [COLOR MOOD] to make the item clear and appealing.
Keep steam, condensation, splashes, crumbs, and reflections plausible and restrained.
Do not add ingredients, increase portions, change packaging, or imply nutrition claims unless confirmed.
Add no price or wording unless [EXACT TEXT] is supplied and later proofread.
Deliver one finished food or beverage image only.

templates.summaryEn: Visualize a supplied garment on a model without changing the garment design.
templates.preserveEn: Keep silhouette, construction, color, print, fabric cues, trims, and branding.
templates.changeEn: Change presentation from flat lay to model, pose, setting, and lighting.
templates.checkEn: Check all garment details and state that fit and sizing are not proven.
templates.prompt:
Create one on-model image from [FLAT-LAY GARMENT PHOTO].
Preserve the garment’s exact silhouette, construction, color, print placement, fabric cues, seams, trims, closures, and branding.
Show it on [MODEL DESCRIPTION] in [POSE] and [SETTING].
Keep the garment’s front/back orientation and layering consistent with [WEAR INSTRUCTION].
Render drape, folds, tension, shadows, and body contact appropriate to the visible fabric.
Do not redesign the garment, alter the print, add pockets, remove labels, or invent unseen details.
Keep hands, limbs, neckline, hem, and garment boundaries anatomically coherent.
Do not claim exact fit, size accuracy, comfort, or real-world appearance on a buyer.
Treat the image as merchandising visualization, not a fitting-room guarantee.
Deliver one on-model image only.

templates.summaryEn: Show a real product being held or used with plausible scale and contact.
templates.preserveEn: Keep product design, size cues, label, color, and functional truth.
templates.changeEn: Change hands, user context, environment, camera angle, and light.
templates.checkEn: Inspect hand anatomy, grip, scale, and avoid inventing product capability.
templates.prompt:
Create one interaction image from [PRODUCT IMAGE].
Preserve the product’s exact shape, dimensions relative to known cues, color, labels, materials, controls, and attachments.
Show [PERSON OR HAND DESCRIPTION] [HOLDING / USING] it in [CONTEXT].
Use [CAMERA ANGLE], [LIGHTING], and [BACKGROUND] appropriate to [MARKETING USE].
Make fingers, grip, pressure, contact points, occlusion, perspective, and shadows anatomically plausible.
Keep the product at a believable scale and orientation.
Do not redesign the item, hide important parts, add accessories, or imply an unsupported function.
Avoid extra fingers, fused hands, floating objects, and impossible use positions.
If the context suggests performance, show only behavior confirmed in [PRODUCT FACTS].
Deliver one finished interaction image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create a single product infographic from a photo and verified specifications.
templates.preserveEn: Keep product appearance and every supplied number, unit, and claim exact.
templates.changeEn: Change layout, callouts, icons, hierarchy, and supporting background.
templates.checkEn: Proofread all text and verify the final production file separately.
templates.prompt:
Create one product-feature infographic from [PRODUCT PHOTO] and [VERIFIED DIMENSIONS, FEATURES, AND SPECIFICATIONS].
Preserve the product’s exact geometry, color, labels, materials, and visible components.
Use a clear [LAYOUT FORMAT] with product image, callout lines, icons, and concise information hierarchy.
Reproduce every supplied number, unit, feature, and qualifier exactly; do not calculate or infer missing values.
Include only these approved claims: [APPROVED CLAIMS].
Use [BRAND PALETTE], [TYPE DIRECTION], and [BACKGROUND] without obscuring the product.
Keep callout lines attached to the correct feature and maintain readable spacing.
Do not invent certifications, compatibility, performance, warranty, or comparative claims.
Treat generated text as a visual draft: manually proofread and typeset the final file.
Deliver one infographic preview image only, not a verified vector or print-production file.

templates.summaryEn: Arrange multiple real product views and approved copy into one long-form visual concept.
templates.preserveEn: Keep all product views consistent and all supplied claims and wording exact.
templates.changeEn: Change section order, graphic hierarchy, backgrounds, callouts, and lifestyle context.
templates.checkEn: Verify copy, dimensions, channel rules, and final layout in a production tool.
templates.prompt:
Create one long-form e-commerce detail-page visual draft from [LABELED PRODUCT IMAGE SET] and [APPROVED COPY].
Preserve the same product model, shape, color, labels, materials, and components across every section.
Organize the page into [SECTION ORDER] for [TARGET CHANNEL AND AUDIENCE].
Use [BRAND PALETTE], [GRAPHIC STYLE], and a consistent spacing system.
Reproduce supplied headlines, dimensions, claims, and qualifiers exactly; do not invent missing copy.
Use lifestyle or detail panels only where supported by the provided product images and facts.
Keep callouts connected to the correct features and avoid contradictory product views.
Do not invent certifications, comparisons, warranties, prices, or performance results.
Treat this as a visual preview; rebuild and proofread precise text, vectors, dimensions, and channel specs in a layout tool.
Deliver one long-page concept image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one high-contrast thumbnail around a verified video topic and optional subject image.
templates.preserveEn: Keep supplied person or object identity and the exact approved title.
templates.changeEn: Change composition, background, expression emphasis, color, and title treatment.
templates.checkEn: Test readability at small size and verify the wording matches the video.
templates.prompt:
Create one YouTube thumbnail for the verified topic [VIDEO TOPIC].
Use [PERSON OR SUBJECT IMAGE] when supplied and preserve its identity, design, and defining features.
Use the exact short title “[APPROVED THUMBNAIL TITLE]”; do not add unsupported claims.
Build a high-contrast [16:9 OR SPECIFIED] composition with one dominant focal point.
Use [BACKGROUND CONCEPT], [PALETTE], and [EMOTIONAL TONE] appropriate to the actual video.
Keep the subject clearly separated from the background without distorted anatomy or cutout halos.
Make title placement readable at small size and keep important content inside safe margins.
Do not invent reactions, results, numbers, logos, or clickbait facts absent from the video.
Treat rendered lettering as a draft and manually proofread the final thumbnail.
Deliver one thumbnail image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one event poster from confirmed event facts and optional approved visual material.
templates.preserveEn: Keep supplied people, products, artwork, brand marks, and event facts exact.
templates.changeEn: Change layout, background, image treatment, hierarchy, and decorative system.
templates.checkEn: Proofread every event detail and rebuild precise type or print files separately.
templates.prompt:
Create one promotional poster for [EVENT NAME] using [OPTIONAL APPROVED KEY VISUAL].
Use only these confirmed facts: [CORE MESSAGE], [DATE AND TIME], [LOCATION OR PARTICIPATION METHOD], and [CTA].
Preserve any supplied person, product, artwork, or brand mark without redesigning it.
Build a clear hierarchy for event name, message, logistics, and call to action.
Use [POSTER STYLE], [PALETTE], [IMAGE TREATMENT], and [FORMAT OR ASPECT RATIO].
Do not invent sponsors, speakers, endorsements, prices, availability, or event details.
Keep all exact wording readable and separate from decorative imagery.
Treat generated lettering as a visual draft requiring manual proofreading and final typesetting.
Verify bleed, resolution, color mode, accessibility, and output dimensions in a production tool when printing.
Deliver one poster preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one sales-moment poster from confirmed promotion details and an optional product image.
templates.preserveEn: Keep the product and every supplied price, discount, date, and condition exact.
templates.changeEn: Change seasonal decor, composition, palette, emphasis, and promotional hierarchy.
templates.checkEn: Proofread offer details and never invent urgency or savings.
templates.prompt:
Create one promotional poster for [HOLIDAY OR SALES MOMENT].
Use [OPTIONAL PRODUCT IMAGE] and preserve the exact product design, label, color, and proportions.
Use only the confirmed offer “[EXACT PROMOTION]”, price “[EXACT PRICE]”, dates “[VALID DATES]”, and conditions “[TERMS]”.
Build a bold hierarchy for campaign name, product, offer, and [CTA].
Use [SEASONAL VISUAL DIRECTION], [PALETTE], and [FORMAT].
Keep decorations supportive and never cover the product or required terms.
Do not invent discounts, savings calculations, scarcity, deadlines, ratings, or endorsements.
Treat generated text as a draft; manually proofread every number, currency, date, and qualifier.
Verify final channel size, safe areas, and print settings outside the image generator.
Deliver one sale-poster preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one formal event poster using confirmed participants, exhibits, and logistics.
templates.preserveEn: Keep supplied portraits or exhibits and all names, titles, organizers, and facts exact.
templates.changeEn: Change grid, visual hierarchy, background, palette, and image treatment.
templates.checkEn: Proofread details and never fabricate speakers, sponsors, or institutional backing.
templates.prompt:
Create one poster for [CONFERENCE / EXHIBITION / TALK TITLE] using [OPTIONAL APPROVED PORTRAIT OR EXHIBIT IMAGE].
Use only confirmed participant names, roles, organizations, date, time, venue, participation method, and CTA from [EVENT FACTS].
Preserve each supplied person’s identity or each supplied exhibit’s appearance.
Build a formal hierarchy for event title, participant information, logistics, and organizer.
Use [VISUAL DIRECTION], [PALETTE], [FORMAT], and restrained supporting graphics.
Do not invent speakers, credentials, sponsors, institutions, awards, or endorsements.
Keep logos undistorted and use only assets explicitly supplied for this event.
Treat generated lettering as a draft requiring line-by-line proofreading and final typesetting.
Verify print bleed, resolution, accessibility, and channel dimensions in a production tool.
Deliver one event-poster preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Turn verified facts and relationships into one clear infographic visual.
templates.preserveEn: Keep all facts, numbers, order, hierarchy, and relationships exactly as supplied.
templates.changeEn: Change iconography, layout, color coding, visual grouping, and emphasis.
templates.checkEn: Validate the information independently; visual coherence is not factual proof.
templates.prompt:
Create one infographic from [VERIFIED FACTS, STRUCTURE, AND RELATIONSHIPS] and [OPTIONAL STRUCTURE SKETCH].
Preserve every supplied fact, number, unit, sequence, category, and relationship exactly.
Use [FLOW / HIERARCHY / COMPARISON / TIMELINE] as the primary information structure.
Design a clear visual hierarchy with [PALETTE], consistent icons, labels, and generous spacing.
Connect elements only according to the supplied relationships; do not infer missing links.
Do not invent statistics, causes, conclusions, citations, or categories.
Keep text concise but do not paraphrase terms whose exact wording matters.
Treat generated lettering, charts, and symbols as a draft requiring factual and typographic review.
Rebuild precise charts, vectors, and accessible text in an appropriate production tool.
Deliver one infographic preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one horizontal cover image that accurately reflects a supplied article topic.
templates.preserveEn: Keep supplied people, products, events, and brand elements faithful.
templates.changeEn: Change visual metaphor, composition, background, palette, and editorial treatment.
templates.checkEn: Ensure the cover adds no event or claim absent from the article.
templates.prompt:
Create one article or newsletter cover for [ARTICLE TOPIC AND SUMMARY].
Use [OPTIONAL APPROVED PERSON / PRODUCT / EVENT IMAGE] when supplied and preserve its identity and factual appearance.
Develop an original editorial visual concept based only on the article’s actual subject.
Use [HORIZONTAL FORMAT], [PALETTE], [BRAND DIRECTION], and [VISUAL METAPHOR].
Reserve clean space for [HEADLINE PLACEMENT] without rendering text unless requested.
If a headline is included, reproduce “[EXACT HEADLINE]” exactly.
Do not add events, outcomes, quotes, logos, people, or claims absent from the article.
Keep imagery clear at email and card-thumbnail sizes.
Treat generated lettering as a draft requiring manual proofreading.
Deliver one cover image only.

templates.summaryEn: Place a real app screenshot into a specified device presentation without altering the interface.
templates.preserveEn: Keep screenshot content and all approved feature claims exact.
templates.changeEn: Change device frame, background, composition, lighting, and marketing context.
templates.checkEn: Verify interface legibility and never imply an unimplemented feature.
templates.prompt:
Create one app device mockup from [ACTUAL APP SCREENSHOT].
Show it on [TARGET DEVICE] and use only the verified feature message “[APPROVED FEATURE CLAIM]”.
Preserve every visible interface element, text, icon, state, and screen proportion from the supplied screenshot.
Fit the screenshot to the display without redrawing, rewriting, or inventing UI.
Use [DEVICE ANGLE], [BACKGROUND], [PALETTE], and [LIGHTING] for [STORE OR WEBSITE USE].
Keep bezels, corners, reflections, perspective, and screen alignment physically coherent.
Do not show features, notifications, ratings, awards, or compatibility not confirmed by the product.
If marketing text is rendered, proofread it and keep it separate from the app UI.
Verify final store dimensions and platform rules outside the generator.
Deliver one mockup preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one menu visual from confirmed dish names, prices, categories, and optional real food photography.
templates.preserveEn: Keep all menu facts and actual dish appearance exact.
templates.changeEn: Change layout, background, decorative system, image crops, and hierarchy.
templates.checkEn: Proofread every name and price and distinguish real dish photos from illustrative concepts.
templates.prompt:
Create one restaurant menu visual using [CONFIRMED DISH NAMES, PRICES, AND CATEGORIES] and [OPTIONAL REAL DISH PHOTO].
Preserve the actual dish appearance when a restaurant photo is supplied.
Organize items under the exact supplied categories with a clear [MENU FORMAT] hierarchy.
Use [BRAND PALETTE], [TYPE DIRECTION], [BACKGROUND], and restrained [DECORATIVE MOTIFS].
Reproduce every dish name, price, currency, qualifier, and category exactly.
Do not invent ingredients, allergens, availability, portion size, offers, or prices.
Clearly distinguish an illustrative food concept from a photograph of the actual dish.
Treat generated lettering as a layout draft requiring line-by-line proofreading and final typesetting.
Verify accessibility, print size, bleed, and digital dimensions in a production tool.
Deliver one menu preview image only.

templates.summaryEn: Create one original logo-concept presentation from a brand brief and optional existing identity assets.
templates.preserveEn: Keep exact brand name and supplied identity assets; avoid third-party marks.
templates.changeEn: Change symbol ideas, letterform direction, geometry, color, and presentation.
templates.checkEn: Run trademark checks and rebuild final vectors and typography separately.
templates.prompt:
Create one logo concept presentation for the exact brand name “[BRAND NAME]”.
Base the concept on [BRAND POSITIONING], [TARGET AUDIENCE], and [BRAND ATTRIBUTES].
If [EXISTING BRAND ASSET] is supplied, preserve its essential identity according to [KEEP / EVOLVE INSTRUCTION].
Explore an original [WORDMARK / SYMBOL / COMBINATION MARK] direction using [FORM LANGUAGE] and [PALETTE].
Keep the mark simple, distinctive, legible, and reproducible at small size.
Do not copy existing logos, protected symbols, or a living designer’s signature work.
Do not invent a slogan; use only “[EXACT TAGLINE]” when supplied.
Present one coherent concept rather than a sheet of unrelated alternatives.
Treat the result as a raster concept: perform trademark research and rebuild approved geometry and type as vectors.
Deliver one logo-concept image only, not final trademark clearance or production files.

templates.summaryEn: Render exact supplied wording as one decorative title treatment.
templates.preserveEn: Keep every character, spelling, order, and supplied letterform reference accurate.
templates.changeEn: Change material effect, depth, lighting, background, and ornamental treatment.
templates.checkEn: Proofread character by character and rebuild editable type separately.
templates.prompt:
Create one display-lettering image for the exact text “[EXACT TEXT]”.
The intended use is [POSTER / PACKAGING / SOCIAL / OTHER] and the language is [LANGUAGE].
If [LETTERFORM OR MATERIAL REFERENCE] is supplied, follow its general shape or material direction without copying unrelated branding.
Apply [MATERIAL EFFECT], [DEPTH], [LIGHTING], [PALETTE], and [BACKGROUND].
Keep every character, accent, punctuation mark, word order, and capitalization exactly as supplied.
Prioritize readability before decorative effects; avoid merged, missing, or invented characters.
Do not add slogans, logos, symbols, or extra words.
Use an original treatment rather than imitating a protected title design or living artist.
Treat the rendered lettering as a visual concept; proofread it and rebuild editable vector/type files for production.
Deliver one title-effect image only.
